property: A self-scope row whose key is wrapped to a node is in that node's default served set, and a node with no wrap receives none of it.
A non-public affiliation has one federation-scope listing row carrying exactly its four listed fields, and the listing door admits it.
An addressed census share is held by its author's node and its recipient's node and by no other.
A privately filed report's reporter and content are served to the duty holder only, never to the person named, unless the duty holder releases them.
For a licence the more restrictive state stands after merge, whatever the asserted instants or ids of the rows.
Every verb the text gives a family is in that family's verb set and has a transition.
A key holding takedown without moderate cannot enable a watchlist for a group.
A watchlist row is admitted only when signed by the group's moderating authority, never by any registered key.
The CommunityStandards withhold window is 30 days and no operator setting changes it.
Content with a removal majority and no keep-decision at window close is in exactly one state, removed or held behind consent, and that state is fixed by rule.
A report filed privately with the duty holder never starts a removal window.
A moderation action carries on a strict majority of the members who voted, not on a fraction of the active roster.
A moderator's act, an age-band adjudication included, takes effect on one signature unless the community set itself a quorum.
A reconsideration is admitted against any prior action or licence its filer has standing over, not only against a takedown notice.
Every takedown notice is signed by a key holding the takedown duty, and a node key holds no judgment duty.
A delegate hands a duty on only where its own grant permits deputising, a Wise Authority seat included.
A chain is admitted exactly when its depth is within the cap in force, which is five by default and may be configured.
A deferral response is refused as unlicensed only where the seat row names a licensing authority.
A key whose only reserved role is log witness cannot raise a person's age band.
A substrate-family emitter is admitted on a live delegation under any root the reader trusts, with no fixed three cosigners required.
The election id is unchanged by a member joining or leaving during the lock.
A publication's subscriber list and a room's own listing are admitted under founder_only although they sit above the family.
A joiner holds no key for an epoch before its admission unless the publisher signed a re-share.
A new member's grant of the current epoch key is emitted at the minter's next sealed write, not at admission.
The archive mode in force for a room is derivable from rows every member holds.
An evicted genesis key is not an admissible signer for the self and is never added back by resolution.
In a community that admits by invitation, a joiner with no contained location proof is still admitted.
A one-member affiliation admits under one voice with countersign and is not refused as founder_only above the family.
A member is seated founder only by a row that carries that member's own signature.
No single occurrence evicts another at once with no window.
After an admitted revocation no grant asserted earlier folds as granted, whether or not the revocation names it.
Every consent decay row is signed by the party running the protocol and never by the substrate.
A grant lapses exactly when its valid_until passes without renewal, and no other member or scope token is read as its clock.
In each partnership half subject_key_id names the other party, and ratification pairs the two halves on that member.
A change short only of signatures is held pending for the hold window and is never refused as a protocol violation.
A community whose geographic constraint admits nobody by containment still admits an invited joiner.
Whether a room with a live founder and no appointed moderator is locked for an election has one answer in every state.
A stale active licence row never overwrites a revocation after merge.
A self-level row never raises the band a person is read at.
A self-declared age row is admitted only when its signer acts for the subject.
An age assurance row is admitted on the same emitter test in the text and in the store, with no scope the text does not name.
Revoking the newest grant never makes an older grant read as granted.
A withdrawal by the agent key named as a subject of the community trust row folds as a boundary, as the owner's does.
An entity revocation is withdrawn by nobody.
A decided retirement can be withdrawn while no frozen row exists for it, and not after.
A signer who was a member at the row's signed instant counts toward the change although it has left since.
An organisation-named licence is admitted and retracted only by the quorum of the authority it names.
A receipt on a best-effort stream is admitted against a producer-signed root with no witness cosignature.
A grant lapses on valid_until alone, independent of expires_at.
A confirmed halt never expires.
A session row without valid_until is refused at the door built from the member table.
A resignation is admitted on the leaving member's signature alone.
Every signed row carries its row mirror, and no signer member sits at the top level of a partnership half.
A moderation row with no subject digest is admitted, and one with a malformed digest is refused.
Every member a family's guard reads is a member of that family's body under the same name.
A sealed chunk has one name for the life of its stream, and an append that collides with it is refused across an epoch roll.
Every row signature, an accord invocation's included, verifies over the JCS of the envelope and no other preimage.
A derived row id is a well-formed attestation_id under the signed object's type, by a stated fold from the digest.
A receipt over a root that was never published is refused, not merely advised against.
A regime row is admitted only from the substrate steward's key.
An evidence row is admitted only from a key holding infra:attest.
A slashing row is admitted only from a holder of the slash duty.
A log cosignature is admitted on the witness identity type under a trusted root, with no further scope required.
A consent state row is admitted from a subject of the target row or a chain rooted at one, and by no owner arm.
An expired stance is admitted only from the substrate and never from a subject or an owner.
A node with one owner and two live owner-signed rows reads steward-bound exactly as it does with one row.
Under a legal hold a withdrawal is admitted and recorded and the descent it would force does not run.
An owned node's route reaches a peer only from its owner's hand or by a referral, never from an announce or the directory.
No rendezvous row of one period replaces or names the row of another, so the periods are unlinkable.
A producer is in breach exactly when the window has passed with the row still present, whatever it had begun.
A confirmed halt is never admitted on a lone signature.
No slashing verdict is admitted from a key that holds neither the slash duty nor a seat on the adjudicating body.
A room's membership rows are never served to a node outside its cohort, a public room's included.
An unannounced identity's occurrence row is offered to no peer that would not also be relayed its attester key.
An addressed member share reaches the named tally member only.
A replacing row is admitted only from the attester of the row it replaces, so a fresh-key rendezvous row replaces nothing.
A Goal's declarer can recant it, and the family has a recant transition.
A need row's signer can recant it, and the family has a recant transition.
A group's Goal is replaced, withdrawn or recanted only by a row cosigned under the group's protocol.
There is one composite per class and period and one partial per seat, and no row replaces either.
